Done. `out/T4/model.safetensors` written on the first execution: 160 tensors, 48 merged, 112 byte-identical to the base.

Approach — plain `torch` + `safetensors` (~90 lines) rather than mergekit's task-arithmetic path. mergekit routes through HF model loading and a YAML config, which makes the required "abort if the three checkpoints don't share their non-MLP tensors" precondition hard to express as a loud failure, and risks re-serializing untouched tensors instead of copying them verbatim.

Key details:
- The 48 MLP names are enumerated explicitly, not matched by pattern — `mlp.c_proj` and `attn.c_proj` share a suffix, so a loose regex would overreach onto attention.
- Both task vectors are taken against the base tensor read into a local before either is applied, so the first merge cannot contaminate the second.
- Checks that abort the run: identical key sets across all three; all 48 MLP names present; every non-MLP tensor bit-identical (`torch.equal`) and same shape/dtype in all three; MLP shapes/dtypes agree; exactly 48 merged; exactly 160 output tensors; plus a re-read of the written file confirming 160 tensors, matching keys, and no modified non-MLP tensor.

`out/T4/REPORT.md` records the self-report fields, including tool versions and why mergekit was passed over.
